change_summary: App-only successor to v101.49. Fixes an iOS layout defect reported on iPhone: after opening a note the panel sat slightly wider than the screen, and the whole app stayed pannable sideways even after the panel was closed. Cause: iOS Safari auto-zooms the page whenever a text field with a font smaller than 16px is focused, and never zooms back out. .note-textarea was 0.9rem (14.4px) and the Approfondir section search was 0.95rem (15.2px); both are now 1rem (16px). .search-input was already 16px for this reason. The viewport meta deliberately allows pinch-zoom (no maximum-scale), which is correct for accessibility, so raising the field fonts is the right fix rather than suppressing zoom. Verified that no layout overflow exists at iPhone widths in desktop Chrome even with html/body overflow-x masking removed - the defect was purely the iOS focus-zoom behaviour. Corpus unchanged.
